en: I research generative models for images and audio. I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University, and my work brings together experience in music, speech and software development.

I also lead the logp(x) generative models research lab at MODULABS and share my research and development experience through corporate training, courses and public talks.

en: I am an independent researcher working on diffusion sampling and generative models for images and audio. In Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, I studied a generalized ODE solver through parameterization of prediction types. In RBF-Solver, I explored multistep sampling with radial basis function interpolation.

Previously, I developed models for source separation, music–lyrics synchronization, speech synthesis and voice conversion at companies including GAUDIOLAB and VIVESTUDIOS. My work on GSEP, HCLAS-X and KimchiSpeech connects with this background in audio and speech.

I continue my research at SteAI and lead logp(x) at MODULABS, where we study the core principles of generative models. I have also taught courses on Stable Diffusion, generative models and Bayesian statistics.

At VIVESTUDIOS, I worked on VSpeech, an integrated TTS and voice conversion model for virtual humans. At SM Entertainment, I developed a singing assessment module for EVERYSING and worked on personalized celebrity TTS. My background also includes Android applications and audio DSP.

가우디오랩에서는 GSEP 음원 분리, GTS 음악·가사 동기화, FOLLE 사운드 생성 모델을 다뤘습니다. 서울대학교에서 작곡과 컴퓨터공학을 함께 공부한 배경을 바탕으로, 음악·음성 기능과 생성 모델을 연구·개발해 왔습니다.
현재는 SteAI에서 이미지·오디오 생성 모델을 연구하며, Dual-Solver(ICLR 2026)와 RBF-Solver를 통해 디퓨전 샘플링의 속도와 품질을 다루고 있습니다. 모두의연구소 랩 운영과 강의 활동도 이어가고 있습니다.
en: I have developed audio and speech technology for music games, karaoke applications and virtual-human projects. My work includes music-game audio output, singing assessment for EVERYSING, personalized celebrity TTS, and VSpeech, an integrated TTS and voice conversion model at VIVESTUDIOS.

At GAUDIOLAB, I worked on GSEP for source separation, GTS for music–lyrics synchronization and FOLLE for sound generation. With a background in composition and computer science at Seoul National University, I have developed both music and speech functions and generative models.

I now research image and audio generation at SteAI, including diffusion sampling speed and quality through Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver. I also lead a MODULABS research lab and continue teaching.

ko: 이미지·오디오 생성 모델을 연구하는 독립 연구자입니다. 서울대학교에서 작곡을 전공하고 컴퓨터공학을 복수전공했으며, 가우디오랩·비브스튜디오스·SM Entertainment 등에서 음악·음성 관련 AI 모델을 개발했습니다.
현재 SteAI에서 디퓨전 샘플링을 연구하며, 대표 연구로 Dual-Solver(ICLR 2026)와 RBF-Solver가 있습니다. 모두의연구소에서 생성 모델 연구 랩 logp(x)를 운영하고, 기업·교육기관 강의와 공개 발표를 통해 경험을 공유합니다.
en: I am an independent researcher working on generative models for images and audio. I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University and developed music and speech AI models at GAUDIOLAB, VIVESTUDIOS and SM Entertainment.

I now research diffusion sampling at SteAI, with work including Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver. I also lead the logp(x) generative models lab at MODULABS and share my experience through corporate and institutional courses and public talks.

original.ko: 인공지능 기술을 활용한 이미지 및 오디오 생성 연구를 하고 있습니다. 여러 스타트업에서 음악 게임, 어플리케이션, 음성 및 사운드와 관련 딥러닝 모델을 개발해 왔습니다. 모두의연구소에서 생성 모델들의 핵심 원리를 연구하는 랩을 운영하고 있고, 이러한 기술들을 널리 알리기 위한 강의 활동도 이어나가고 있습니다.
original.en: I conduct research on generative models for images and audio. I have developed deep learning models related to music games and applications, as well as speech and sound, across multiple startups. I currently work as an independent researcher based on this experience. I also lead a lab at MODULABS that studies core principles of generative models, and I continue to teach courses to help disseminate these techniques.
